rulesStrings.li: story(priority=-999)->The movement grew slowly, as small crews carried its values between the stars.
setup(tag=meme_ST_UFP) -> In an age of border skirmishes and mistrust, [founderName] saw that lasting security would only come from cooperation, science, and clear principles.

setup(tag=meme_ST_UFP) -> While serving on the [place_summary] [place_name], [founderName] watched one crisis after another and realized that power without ethics would destroy the Federation from within.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_ST_UFP) -> On a frontier station, [founderName] refused to fire the first shot during a tense standoff, buying time to negotiate a fragile but lasting treaty.

story(uses=1,tag=meme_ST_UFP) -> When a disaster struck a neutral world, [founderName] diverted ships from a strategic position to lead a relief effort, proving that compassion could deter enemies better than any show of force.

story(uses=1,tag=meme_ST_UFP) -> During a mission beyond known space, [founderName] enforced the principle of non-interference, even when intervention would have brought the Federation an easy advantage.

story(uses=1,tag=meme_ST_UFP) -> Before the Council, [founderName] argued that exploration fleets must answer first to a code of conduct, not to fear, and swore to uphold that standard on every assignment.
episode(priority=-1)->
creation(tag=meme_ST_Klingon) -> In the first age of steel and blood, warriors on the [place_summary] [place_name] swore that a life without worthy battle was no life at all.
creation(tag=meme_ST_Klingon) -> When the houses were weak and divided, a circle of warriors carved their oaths into the blades of their fathers and vowed that honor would outlive any empire.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_ST_Klingon) -> At the great hall, [founderName] demanded that cowards be named and cast out, so that no dishonored blood would weaken the line of warriors.

episode(uses=1,tag=meme_ST_Klingon) -> When a rival house gained power through deceit instead of combat, [founderName] challenged its leader before the assembled warriors and defeated [foeLeader_objective] in single combat.

episode(uses=1,tag=meme_ST_Klingon) -> In the fires of a captured stronghold, [founderName] ordered the enemy banners burned, swearing that only the stories of honored foes would be remembered in song.

episode(uses=1,tag=meme_ST_Klingon) -> After losing a campaign through treachery, [founderName] chose to live and bear the shame, so that future warriors could learn never to trust an enemy who fears open battle.
intro(tag=meme_ST_Romulan) -> The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] lived behind carefully guarded borders, trusting only in the quiet strength of their command structure.
intro(tag=meme_ST_Romulan) -> On the [place_summary] [place_name], orders flowed from hidden chambers to distant outposts, and loyalty to the state mattered more than any single life.
conflict(tag=meme_ST_Romulan) -> A [foeLeader] sought to expose classified operations to foreign powers, using [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] and stolen archives.
conflict(tag=meme_ST_Romulan) -> Factions within the government turned information into a weapon, and border captains no longer knew whose orders could be trusted.

founderJoin(tag=meme_ST_Romulan) -> A strategist named [founderName] mapped every border incident and uncovered the patterns of betrayal, proving that only centralized, disciplined command could keep the empire secure.
founderJoin(tag=meme_ST_Romulan) -> After intercepting a secret transmission, [founderName] revealed how careless speech and divided loyalties had nearly invited an invasion.

victory(tag=meme_ST_Romulan) -> With the conspirators removed and their networks dismantled, [founderName] established new codes and protocols, ensuring that information would flow only along trusted lines.
victory(tag=meme_ST_Romulan) -> The borders held firm, enemies saw only silence beyond the neutral zone, and the people learned that survival depended on obedience and discretion.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> On my first day at the exchange, I learned something that every poor fool around me had missed:
lessonIntro(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> When a cousin tried to cheat me out of a contract, I finally understood this:
lessonIntro(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> After losing three fortunes and making four, I realized one simple rule:
lessonIntro(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> While others prayed to distant powers, I watched the flow of latinum and saw the real truth:
lesson(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> profit is not an accident, it is the result of noticing opportunities that everyone else is too polite to take
lesson(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> a promise without collateral is just noise, and noise has no market value
lesson(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> if both sides walk away happy, you mispriced something
lesson(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> family is important, but only a fool forgets to charge them interest
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> That is why every deal, every smile, and every favor must be counted in strips of latinum.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> Remember this the next time someone offers you a friendship discount.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> Those who forget it end up working for those who do not.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_ST_Ferengi) -> Write it down as a new rule, and make sure you collect interest on the lesson.
